items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: they used to talk about Les Brown’s being tight, Harry’s band was unbelievably tight.

ctx.x: Trying to be consistent you know and accurate, accurate. That helps. But then the other thing which you may have, when I would ask a student I say “What do I mean when I say you’ve got to be consistent?” And they say, “Well that means you don’t have to clam a note.” I said, “No, that’s not what I’m talking about.” “Well what are you talking about?” “Okay if you’re going to be a lead trumpet player you have to be very disciplined. You have to phrase, you have to lengthen the notes, everything has to be exactly the…
